summary: KONGSVINGER FESTNINGS VENNER (org. no. 987 472 758) is an association (FLI) based in Kongsvinger, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2005-03-15. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 94.992 (Aktiviteter i andre medlemsorganisasjoner ellers); it has 0 registered employees. CEO: Vidar Borge; board chair: Vidar Borge.
